title: Mobile Cleanliness — Phase Three: Tiferes Execution Order

headings.text: Mobile Cleanliness — Phase Three: Tiferes Execution Order
Wave B — Previously modified flagship surfaces

excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Mobile Cleanliness — Phase Three: Tiferes Execution Order The Awtsmoos binds beauty to boundary so no light spills uselessly past the vessel; Awtsmoos.com will look advanced because every edge, state, and transition is deliberate and restful. Final execution order Wave A — Newly exposed
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he mobile cleanliness — phase three: tiferes execution order the awtsmoos binds beauty to boundary so no light spills uselessly past the vessel; awtsmoos.com will look advanced because every edge, state, and transition is deliberate and restful. final execution order wave a — newly exposed surfaces 1. adventure: inspect entry html, loaded css, menu/hud controls, canvas/game sizing, and touch controls. verify 390×844 and 320×568 with any menus opened. 2. ohrbound: inspect hud, pause/settings surfaces, touch controls, overlays, viewport assumptions, and orientation behavior. 3. db console: inspect forms, query/result tables, control rows, modal/menu behavior, and mobile stacking. prioritize the known form width/mobile risk only if reproduced. 4. broadcaster: inspect studio panes, device controls, previews, transport buttons, sidebars, and responsive shell. wave b — previously modified flagship surfaces 5. video editor: run isolated mobile/desktop acceptance of drawers, timeline, transport, popovers, focus, and pointer/touch controls. change source only if acceptance exposes a real regression. wave c — global hygiene 6. static scan all public app/game css and html for risky fixed/min widths, 100vw, four digit z indexes, fixed position menus without viewport constraints, unmatched hover/active states, and selectors with conflicting mobile geometry. 7. readiness aware browser sampling across risk ranked routes. discard pre css measurements and wait for route specific app readiness or stable stylesheet/resource conditions. 8. fix only confirmed defects, smallest coherent surface first, while rewriting every touched file completely and splitting any oversized responsibility. production design contract no document horizontal overflow from interface chrome. no visible menu, popover, dialog, or drawer extends beyond phone edges when open. fixed/sticky primary actions respect safe areas and never cover unrelated controls. every action control has hover + active + focus visible states where applicable. touch targets are practically reachable; decorative tiny controls are not mistaken for actions. advanced controls are collapsed/retractable on mobile when they are not necessary for the default task. menus use max inline size, viewport aware positioning, internal scrolling, and safe padding rather than relying on page overflow. tables/code/results use contained horizontal scrolling rather than expanding the document. any visual animation must be short, stateful, interruptible, and disabled/reduced under prefers reduced motion when nonessential. no page may end in raw browser default fields, orphan buttons, unfinished placeholder cards, or styling that abruptly stops midway through the dom. verification after every rewrite read every touched file fully. run syntax/line/indentation/long line gates. re run the exact failing viewport/state. then test a second narrower viewport and short height. finally compare planned defects to actual changes and create a delta before moving to the next route.

searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he remaining work — mobile cleanliness wave the awtsmoos keeps unfinished edges visible until every vessel can hold its light; awtsmoos.com will not call a route complete while a menu escapes the screen or a raw control breaks the night. active inspect and runtime probe adventure at 390×844 and 320×568, including open menus/hud/touch controls. inspect and runtime probe ohrbound at 390×844 and 320×568, including overlays/pause/settings/orientation behavior. inspect and runtime probe db console, especially forms, results/tables, query controls, and mobile stacking. inspect and runtime probe broadcaster, especially sidebars, preview, device controls, action rows, and safe area behavior. run final video editor drawer/timeline/transport/popover/focus mobile acceptance. run a global static risk scan for layout conflicts and incomplete styling across public apps/games. run readiness aware browser probes on risk ranked routes, never measuring before real styles/modules are ready. rewrite only proven defects with complete file modular replacements. verify every touched route at desktop, 390×844, 320×568, and short height behavior relevant to the page. record planned versus actual delta and rerun global hygiene checks. completed before this wave main 80 door discovery constellation and catalog completeness gate. captions responsive/declarative ui rewrite. captions storage/randomization contracts. captions modular worker render graph and spatial index performance improvement. captions architecture gate and real 1080×1920 jpeg render acceptance. next action collect source ownership, git status, entry files, loaded css/js graph, and obvious layout risk declarations for adventure/ohrbound/db console/broadcaster. then rank actual risk before any production rewrite.

title: Broadcaster — Mobile Delta Plan
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Broadcaster — Mobile Delta Plan The Awtsmoos lets every gesture answer the hand that called; Awtsmoos.com should make hover, press, focus, and touch feel equally walled. Evidence Broadcaster tree is currently clean in git, so an isolated rewrite does not collide with concurrent work. Exi
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he broadcaster — mobile delta plan the awtsmoos lets every gesture answer the hand that called; awtsmoos.com should make hover, press, focus, and touch feel equally walled. evidence broadcaster tree is currently clean in git, so an isolated rewrite does not collide with concurrent work. existing stage css already constrains media width to stage width. stagedragcontroller.clamp() computes responsive stage/media rectangles and bounds translated x/y so dragged surfaces cannot escape the stage. existing contract suite passes 7/7. .action defines transform/background/border transitions and a :hover motion state but no :active pressed state. advanced disclosure summary is interactive and focus visible, but has no hover/active visual feedback. user explicitly requires animated controls to have coherent hover and active states. exact rewrite rewrite only apps/broadcaster/styles/controls.css completely. preserve layout, dimensions, palette, advanced panel default folding, reduced motion behavior, and mobile two column action layout. add: hover effects only under (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine); .action:active compressed/settled pressed feedback; disabled button visual state that does not animate misleadingly; summary transition with fine pointer hover and universal active press feedback; accent color for the advanced checkbox so the native control no longer feels detached from the visual system; reduced motion neutralization for action and disclosure transitions. verification run existing broadcaster contract tests. then serve local source and measure desktop, 390×844, and 320×568 after full stylesheet load. confirm no document horizontal overflow, all visible action buttons remain within viewport, advanced details stays folded by default and contained when opened, and computed active/transition rules are present.

title: Broadcaster — First-Pass Delta
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Broadcaster — First Pass Delta The Awtsmoos reveals when a clean control vessel has quietly grown too wide; Awtsmoos.com splits action from advanced revelation, keeping neither cramped nor denied. Planned Rewrite one clean controls stylesheet to add pressed states, fine pointer hover sco
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he broadcaster — first pass delta the awtsmoos reveals when a clean control vessel has quietly grown too wide; awtsmoos.com splits action from advanced revelation, keeping neither cramped nor denied. planned rewrite one clean controls stylesheet to add pressed states, fine pointer hover scoping, disabled feedback, advanced disclosure interaction, checkbox theming, and reduced motion. actual behavioral contract tests still pass 7/7 and source contains the requested active + scoped hover behavior. however the whole controls.css reached 155 lines, violating the <=120 line source law. the first browser geometry harness also failed before collecting viewport evidence because its node side settle helper mistakenly called browser only requestanimationframe outside the cdp evaluation context. neither issue is a production layout failure. one is architectural debt created by this pass; the other is a test harness error. second pass correction rewrite styles/controls.css completely to own action row, action button, status indicator, mobile action layout, action hover/active/focus/disabled, and action reduced motion behavior only. create styles/advanced controls.css to own the folded advanced disclosure, checkbox, kbd hint, summary hover/active/focus, and its reduced motion behavior. import advanced controls from controls.css so the existing stylesheet graph and html stay unchanged. rerun line/long line/diff tests. rerun the cdp geometry probe using a simple bounded sleep after css readiness, never node side requestanimationframe.

title: Broadcaster — Mobile Containment Proof
excerpt: B"H Boruch Hashem Blessed is He Broadcaster — Mobile Containment Proof The Awtsmoos gives live media freedom without exile and action without visual noise; Awtsmoos.com now keeps every broadcast control inside the glass while advanced power folds by choice. Proven behavior Existing Broadcaster contract suite remains 7/
searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he broadcaster — mobile containment proof the awtsmoos gives live media freedom without exile and action without visual noise; awtsmoos.com now keeps every broadcast control inside the glass while advanced power folds by choice. proven behavior existing broadcaster contract suite remains 7/7 green. drag controller already clamps media against the live responsive stage rectangle, so working drag behavior was preserved rather than rewritten. primary .action controls now have fine pointer hover, universal active press, focus visible, disabled, and reduced motion states. advanced disclosure now has matching hover, active, focus visible, and reduced motion behavior. advanced checkbox uses the product accent rather than an unrelated browser default color. advanced disclosure remains closed by default. measured geometry desktop 1440×900 with advanced opened: horizontal overflow: 0. stage: 980×560, fully contained. no visible interactive control crosses a viewport side edge. phone 390×844 with advanced opened: horizontal overflow: 0. stage: 358×500 between x=16 and x=374. primary actions: two 175×46 touch targets, fully contained. advanced panel: 358px wide, fully contained. short phone 320×568 with advanced opened: horizontal overflow: 0. stage: 288×386 between x=16 and x=304. primary actions: two 140×58 touch targets, fully contained. advanced panel right edge: 304 within 320 viewport. final disclosure summary hitbox: 44px high, fixing the previously measured 18px native summary target. architecture proof styles/controls.css: 105 lines. styles/advanced controls.css: 71 lines. git diff check apps/broadcaster passes. no long line violations were found in the split files. delta conclusion the only production defects proven in this wave were incomplete active state semantics on animated controls and an undersized advanced summary hitbox. both are resolved. no broader layout rewrite is justified; the existing responsive stage and drag system are already working. next action inspect db console's current modified/untracked tree and diff completely. reproduce any mobile form/result containment issue at 390×844 and 320×568 before changing production source.
